DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書をお渡しします。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here are your certificates. Please check their contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前と住所は合っています。提出先へ持って行くので、折らずに入れられる封筒はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明内容確認後に折らない封筒を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The name and address are correct. I am taking one to the organization requesting it. Do you have an envelope that will hold it without folding?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After checking the certificate details, ask for an envelope that does not require folding it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの大きい封筒をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can give you this large envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。提出用と自分の控えを分けて入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出用と控えを分けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I would like to put the copy for submission and the copy for my records in separate envelopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to separate the submission copy and your own copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今お渡しした二通のうち、一通を提出なさるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you will submit one of the two certificates I just gave you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一通は提出し、もう一通は家で保管します。封筒を二枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各一通の用途と二封筒を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will submit one and keep the other at home. Could I have two envelopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain what each certificate is for and ask for two envelopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二枚お渡しします。提出先の指定があれば、そちらもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are two. Please also check any requirements from the organization receiving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内には原本を一通とあります。提出用の封筒に提出先、保管用の封筒には今日の日付を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本一通の指定を示し各封筒に提出先と保管日付を書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The instructions say to submit one original. I will write the recipient on the submission envelope and today's date on the storage envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the requirement for one original, and say you will write the recipient and the storage date on the respective envelopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出用と保管用を、封筒の表示で区別できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The labels on the envelopes will distinguish the submission copy from the storage copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つに分けられました。日付を書いた保管用は青いファイルへ入れ、提出用だけ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二封筒を区別し保管用をファイルへ入れ提出用を持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have separated them into two envelopes. I will put the dated storage envelope in my blue folder and take only the submission envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two envelopes, put the storage copy in a folder, and say you will take the submission copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回は検査と診察の予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your next visit is scheduled for tests and a consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の休憩中に来たいのですが、検査と診察は続けてできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査診察を仕事休憩中に続けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to come during my work break. Can the tests and consultation be done one after the other?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the tests and consultation can be done consecutively during your work break. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定の流れを確認します。来られる時間はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the planned sequence. How much time do you have to come in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二時から一時までです。一時間で終わると決まっているわけではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時間の空きと所要時間確約なしを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: From noon until one. There is no guarantee that it will be finished in an hour, is there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you have one hour available and confirm that the duration is not guaranteed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待ち時間などで変わります。必要な時間の目安を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It depends on things such as the waiting time. Let us ask the staff in charge for an estimate of the time needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。難しければ、午後の仕事を休める日に予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足なら午後休みの日へ予約希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If that would be difficult, I would like to book for a day when I can take the afternoon off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that if the time is insufficient, you want an appointment on a day when you have the afternoon off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 翌週の水曜日なら、予約の候補があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a possible appointment on Wednesday of the following week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水曜日は午後を空けられます。その日に検査も診察もまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌週水曜午後に両方まとめる希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can keep Wednesday afternoon free. I would like to have both the tests and the consultation on that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to combine both on Wednesday afternoon of the following week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当と枠を確認します。検査前の準備も予約が決まってから説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the staff in charge and confirm the available slots. Once the appointment is set, we will also explain how to prepare for the tests.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水曜日を希望します。準備の説明を聞き、職場には午後の休みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水曜予約と準備説明を受け午後休みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would prefer Wednesday. I will listen to the preparation instructions and discuss taking the afternoon off with my workplace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a Wednesday appointment, receive the preparation instructions, and say you will discuss taking the afternoon off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付でご案内します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will assist you at reception. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 首輪をした犬が、一匹で道を歩いています。飼い主らしい人は見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 首輪犬が単独歩行し飼主不在と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A dog wearing a collar is walking along the street by itself. I cannot see anyone who looks like its owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a collared dog walking alone with no owner in sight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今はどの辺りにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商店街の入口です。茶色の中型犬で、歩道を歩いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商店街入口と犬の色大きさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the entrance to the shopping street. It is a medium-sized brown dog, walking on the sidewalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the shopping street entrance as the location and describe the dog's color and size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状況を確認します。近づいたり、捕まえたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the situation. Have you approached it or tried to catch it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。少し離れて見ています。犬は今、店の前で止まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未接近で離れて見守り店前停止を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I am watching from a little distance. The dog has now stopped in front of a shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you have not approached it, are watching from a distance, and it has stopped outside a shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を伺います。近くに目印になるお店はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me ask about the location. Is there a nearby shop we can use as a landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い看板のパン屋です。車道にはまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤看板パン屋と車道未進入を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a bakery with a red sign. The dog has not gone into the roadway yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the bakery with the red sign and say the dog has not entered the roadway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。ご自身が安全な場所にいるようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will inform the staff in charge. Please make sure you stay somewhere safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: パン屋の入口の横にいます。場所が変わったら、見えた範囲で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な入口横から見えた場所変化を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am beside the bakery entrance. If its location changes, I will report what I can see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report visible changes in location from a safe spot beside the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。こちらで状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for contacting us. We will check the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about a missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日この票が入っていました。今日は夕方に家へ戻るので、再配達をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票を示し当日夕方後の再配達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice was left yesterday. I will be back home this evening, so I would like to request redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the missed-delivery notice and request redelivery after you return that evening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票の番号を確認します。ご希望の日は本日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the number on the notice. Would you like delivery today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。帰宅が六時ごろなので、それより後の時間帯を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅六時以降の時間帯を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will get home around six, so I would prefer a time slot after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a time slot after your return home at six. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付できる時間帯を確認します。本日は午後七時から九時の枠をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the available time slots. Today we can offer the seven-to-nine p.m. slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その枠をお願いします。六時には帰宅しているので、家で待って受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内枠を選び在宅して待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like that slot, please. I will be home by six, so I will wait at home to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the offered slot and say you will be home waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お届け先は、不在票にある住所でお変わりありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the delivery address still the address on the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変わりません。部屋番号も合っています。玄関の呼び鈴が聞こえる部屋で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所部屋番号と呼鈴が聞こえる待機室を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it has not changed. The apartment number is also correct. I will wait in a room where I can hear the front doorbell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the address and apartment number, and the room where you will wait within hearing of the doorbell. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お申し込みを承りました。不在票は配達時にも確認できるようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your request has been accepted. Please keep the notice available so it can also be checked at delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 票を玄関の棚へ置きます。帰宅してから受け取る予定が決まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 玄関棚に不在票を用意し帰宅後受取を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the notice on the shelf by the entrance. The arrangements to receive it after I get home are now settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the notice ready on the entrance shelf and have arranged to receive the delivery after coming home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その時間帯で受け付けます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will book that time slot, then. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取引明細についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about transaction statements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 個人事業の帳簿を付けています。会計ソフトへ読み込める形式で、この口座の明細を取り出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個人事業帳簿用に取引明細のソフト読込形式を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am keeping accounts for my sole proprietorship. I would like to export the statements for this account in a format that my accounting software can import.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a software-importable transaction statement format for your sole-proprietor bookkeeping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用のサービスで出力できる形式を担当が確認します。ソフトの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff in charge will check which formats your service can export. Do you have the software instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内です。CSVを選ぶと書いてあります。画面の写真を読み込む方法ではないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: CSV指定のソフト案内を示し画像ではないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are the instructions. They say to select CSV. It does not seem to be a method of importing a photograph of the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the software instructions specifying CSV and explain that it is not an image import. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この口座の明細は、インターネットの利用画面からCSVで出力できます。必要な期間はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can export this account's statements as CSV from the online service screen. What period do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四月一日から六月三十日までです。三か月分をまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四月から六月末の三か月出力期間を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: From April first through June thirtieth. I would like to combine three months' worth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify a three-month export period from April through the end of June. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期間を指定して出力する操作を、見本画面でご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to specify the period and export it using a sample screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開始日と終了日を別々に入れるのですね。保存したファイル名に期間を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始終了日操作を理解し期間付きファイル名を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I enter the start and end dates separately. I would like to include the period in the saved file's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand entering the start and end dates, and say you want the period in the filename. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ソフトへ取り込む操作は、そのソフトの案内をご確認ください。こちらでは明細の出力までご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: For importing into the software, please check that software's instructions. We can guide you through exporting the statements here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出力する所まで分かりました。家で三か月を指定して保存し、ソフトの案内を見ながら取り込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行出力説明を終え自宅で保存後ソフト案内で読込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the steps up to exporting. At home, I will specify the three months and save the file, then import it while following the software instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish the bank's export explanation and say you will save the file at home, then import it using the software instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な点があれば、出力の窓口へご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: If anything is unclear, please ask the export support desk. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍の餃子を買いたいです。でも先に日用品の買い物が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍餃子購入と残る日用品買物を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy frozen dumplings. But I still need to shop for household supplies first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss buying frozen dumplings while still having household shopping left to do. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 冷凍売場は奥です。ほかの品物を選んでから戻ると、持ち歩く時間を短くできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The frozen foods section is at the back. If you choose the other items and then return, you can reduce the time you carry the frozen food around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうします。餃子の種類だけ先に見て、取るのは最後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷凍品の種類だけ見て最後に取ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will do that. I will just look at the types of dumplings first and pick them up last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to look only at the frozen food varieties and pick them up last. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが小袋、こちらが大袋です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: These are small bags, and these are large bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家では二人で食べるので、小袋に決めます。今は洗剤を見に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人用小袋を決め先に洗剤売場へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two of us eating at home, so I will choose a small bag. I will go and look at detergent now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a small bag for two people and go to the detergent section first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保冷袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have an insulated bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、鞄にあります。冷凍品を取った後、この袋へ入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参保冷袋で持ち帰ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it is in my bag. After I pick up the frozen food, I will put it in this insulated bag and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will take it home in the insulated bag you brought. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計は手前のレジをご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the checkout at the front to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗剤を選べました。小袋の餃子を最後に取り、手前のレジへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 洗剤選択後に冷凍品を取り近いレジへ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have chosen the detergent. I will pick up the small bag of dumplings last, then go to the checkout at the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After choosing detergent, pick up the frozen food and go to the nearby checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で帽子が柵の内側へ飛びました。あの低い枝に引っかかっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柵内の枝に飛ばされた帽子を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind blew my hat inside the fence. It is caught on that low branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your hat has blown onto a branch inside the fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。どの辺りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check where it is. Whereabouts is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左の木です。灰色の帽子で、枝の先に見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木位置色と枝先の現物を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the tree on the left. The hat is gray, and you can see it at the tip of the branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the tree's location, the color, and the actual hat at the branch tip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員で対応できるか見てきます。こちらの通路でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will go and see whether our staff can retrieve it. Please wait on this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私はこちらから見える所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職員対応を頼み指定通路で待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will wait in a spot visible from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to retrieve it and wait on the designated path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帽子を取れました。こちらの灰色の物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We retrieved the hat. It is this gray one, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私の帽子です。ひもが切れたので、今日は鞄へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収現物を確認し切れたひものため収納を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, that is my hat. The strap broke, so I will put it in my bag today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the retrieved hat and decide to put it away because the strap broke. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 風が強くなっています。ほかに落とした物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The wind is getting stronger. Have you dropped anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帽子だけです。取っていただけたので、帰る前に鞄へしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他落物なしと鞄収納済みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just the hat. Since you retrieved it for me, I have put it in my bag before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have dropped nothing else and have already put the hat in your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しできてよかったです。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad we could return it. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機のお手続きはお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished using the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符は買えましたが、領収書のボタンを押し忘れました。まだ画面が終わっていないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符購入後領収書未選択の画面を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought my ticket, but I forgot to press the receipt button. It looks like the screen has not finished yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the screen after buying a ticket without selecting a receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の画面を確認します。購入内容が残っているので、こちらで領収書を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the current screen. The purchase details are still there, so you can select a receipt here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このボタンですね。会社へ交通費を出すので、領収書も持って帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社交通費用の領収書を希望しボタンを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This button, right? I am submitting my travel expenses to my company, so I would like to take a receipt home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a receipt for company travel expenses and confirm the button. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ボタンを押すと、切符とは別の受け口から出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you press the button, it comes out of a separate slot from the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 押しました。下の細い口から出た紙が領収書ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 操作後別受口から領収書受領を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I pressed it. The paper that came out of the narrow slot below is the receipt, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After pressing the button, confirm receipt collection from the separate slot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、金額と日付をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check the amount and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額は買った切符と同じで、日付も今日です。切符は財布へ、領収書は書類入れへ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額日付確認と切符領収書別収納を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount matches the ticket I bought, and the date is today. I will put the ticket in my wallet and the receipt separately in my document holder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the amount and date and say you will store the ticket and receipt separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お釣りもお取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you collect your change too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取りました。領収書も受け取れたので、帰って交通費の申請に添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣銭受領と交通費申請添付を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I also received the receipt, so when I get back I will attach it to my travel expense claim.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you collected the change and will attach the receipt to your travel expense claim. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an application form with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書いてから、電話番号を一桁間違えたことに気づきました。書き直す用紙をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話番号の誤記で新用紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: After filling it out, I noticed I had written one digit of my phone number incorrectly. Could I have another form to write it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a new form because of a mistake in your phone number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの申請書か確認します。この欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check which application form this is. It is this field, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ほかの欄は書けています。訂正できるなら、その方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他欄は記入済みで訂正方法も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have filled in the other fields. If corrections are allowed, please tell me how to make one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the other fields are complete and also ask how to correct the mistake. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当窓口で訂正の扱いをご案内します。今はまだ提出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The desk in charge will explain how corrections are handled. Have you not submitted it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。消せないペンで書いたので、ここだけ自分で修正液を使ってよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出かつ消せないペンで修正に迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I wrote it in non-erasable pen, so I was unsure whether I could use correction fluid on just this part myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it has not been submitted, was written in non-erasable pen, and you were unsure about correcting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の説明を聞いてから直しましょう。新しい用紙もご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us correct it after you hear the explanation from the staff in charge. We can also provide a new form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい用紙を一枚お願いします。もし書き直す場合は、正しい番号をこのメモから写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予備新用紙と正番号メモを用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One new form, please. If I have to fill it in again, I will copy the correct number from this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare a spare new form and a note of the correct number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用紙をお渡しします。担当窓口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the form. The desk in charge is this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。間違った用紙と新しい用紙、番号のメモを持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧新用紙とメモを持ち担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will take the incorrect form, the new form, and the note with the number to ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the old and new forms and the note to consult the desk in charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらへどうぞ。ご来庁ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, this way, please. Thank you for visiting our office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先生から薬が出ると言われましたが、処方箋をまだ受け取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察で薬予定と未受領処方箋を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The doctor said I would be prescribed medicine, but I have not received the prescription yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the medicine planned at your consultation and the prescription you have not received. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お会計の受付でお渡しする流れです。受付票をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The prescription is handed over at the payment counter. Do you have your reception slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。薬もこの建物の中で受け取ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付票所持と院内受薬の認識を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought I would also receive the medicine inside this building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the reception slip and thought you would receive the medicine in the clinic. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お薬は院外の薬局でご相談ください。処方箋の受け取り時に説明もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask a pharmacy outside the clinic about the medicine. We will also explain when you receive your prescription.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。処方箋を受け取ってから、薬局へ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 処方箋後に院外薬局へ行くと理解を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. After receiving the prescription, I will take it to a pharmacy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you understand you will go to an outside pharmacy after receiving the prescription. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け取ったら、お名前や記載をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you receive it, please check your name and the written details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認します。今日は時間が少ないので、先に会計の番号札を取ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名記載確認と会計順番を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I do not have much time today, so may I take a payment queue number first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the name and details and ask about the payment queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付票をこちらへお出しください。会計待ちのご案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand in your reception slip here. We will explain how to wait for payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付票を出します。処方箋も忘れず受け取り、その後薬局へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付票を提出し会計処方箋受領後に薬局へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my reception slip. I will make sure to receive the prescription too, and then go to the pharmacy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand in your reception slip and say you will go to the pharmacy after payment and prescription collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、会計へご案内します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will direct you to payment. Take care.
